hints.title: Core Insight
hints.text: Assign a ranking to each employee salary within their respective department.

hints.title: Algorithmic Structure
hints.text: Use dense ranking so that employees with identical salaries share the same ranking position without skipping following numbers.

hints.title: State Transitions
hints.text: Filter the resulting rows where the assigned ranking equals two and order the output by employee id.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
WITH RankedEmployees AS (
    SELECT 
        emp_id, 
        dept, 
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rk
    FROM Employees
)
SELECT 
    emp_id, 
    dept
FROM RankedEmployees
WHERE rk = 2
ORDER BY emp_id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Evaluates in optimal O(n * log(n)) runtime.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force exhaustive search exceeds the time limit.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Uses O(n) auxiliary memory for optimal state tracking.
